title: Code of Practice for Improved Thatching of Roof with Rot and Fire Retardant Treatment
clause_1_scope: 1.1 This code covers essentially the technology of making rot and fire retardant thatches for rural and slum areas.
clause_3_terminology: Code of Practice for Improved Thatching of Roof with Rot and Fire Retardant Treatment

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
